biotools.summary: A paired dataset containing potato tuber samples collected in Hokkaido, Japan. It combines multi-sensory data (RGB-D point clouds, ground measurements, SfM reconstructions) to benchmark and train algorithms for 3D phenotyping and data completion.
biotools.name: 3D Potato Twin
